verdict.rationale: The only maintenance signals are a published npm release (ultrametric@0.4.1) and a recorded fix: the `arena` commands failed on 2026-10-07 and worked again on 2026-10-08 after a worker fix was deployed. That shows some active upkeep, but it is a server-side data-path fix rather than a new release, and nothing shows a public issue tracker or community involvement. Missing for 10: release history or changelog with dates, evidence of public issue triage, evidence of accepted community contributions, independent corroboration of maintenance cadence.
